# SaltWatch Card 0.6.3 beta 1

This beta keeps the divider between paired salt-level and forecast metrics
centered on their primary values and labels when forecast progress or another
explanation appears below the forecast.

## What changed

- Separated forecast explanations from the primary paired-metric row so their
  height no longer pulls the divider out of alignment.
- Scoped the alternate layout to paired metrics with an explanation; numeric
  forecasts and forecast-only cards keep their existing structure.
- Preserved the horizontal divider and spacing used by narrow stacked cards.
- Preserved the compact side-by-side layout used by very short fixed-height
  cards.
- Kept long custom forecast details contained within the forecast column.

## Compatibility

- No configuration changes are required.
- Forecast values, status handling, translations, actions, tank rendering, and
  low-marker behavior are unchanged.
- The fix applies to both SaltWatch device discovery and manually mapped water
  softener entities.

## Validation

- 55 unit tests passed.
- 47 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile Chromium; one desktop-only
  mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- Browser coverage includes every built-in unavailable-forecast explanation,
  English, German, Danish, long custom detail text, natural and fixed heights,
  stacked metrics, and compact side-by-side metrics.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
